question_text: Alexander Hamilton is famous for many things. Name one.

official_answers.text: One of the writers of the Federalist Papers
Helped establish the First Bank of the United States

why_it_matters.text: Alexander Hamilton built the U.S. financial system from scratch — as the first Secretary of the Treasury, he created the national bank, set up the currency, and figured out how to pay off the country's war debts. He was Washington's right-hand officer during the Revolution and wrote most of the Federalist Papers defending the new Constitution.

fun_fact.text: Alexander Hamilton was born poor on the tiny Caribbean island of Nevis — he was an illegitimate child orphaned at 11. At 17, he wrote so beautifully that townspeople raised money to send him to America for an education. He arrived in New York with nothing and went on to create the U.S. financial system from scratch.
